proof_summary: A finite suffix analysis establishes a stable cascade for iterated run-length transforms, yielding the recurrence \(L_{k+7}=3L_{k+6}-3L_{k+5}+L_{k+4}+L_k\) for the row lengths. Powers of its companion matrix are comparable to shifted \(L_k\), so subadditivity of their logarithmic norms gives a limiting exponential rate; the row sums have the same rate by \(L_{n-1}\le S_n\le nL_{n-1}\).
